propositions: Closing a ticket invokes _compact_on_close which holds the store write lock for unbounded duration (measured 13m53s), blocking all concurrent agent writes
The compact_txn._compact_locked function acquires a single store write lock and holds it through the entire compaction fold including git operations, with no timeout on the hold duration itself
Compaction is optional housekeeping and not required for correctness; unfolded event logs are valid and the reducer replays them normally
The fix removes _compact_on_close and its call site from the close path, reducing close lock-hold time to seconds while preserving the ability to compact via manual rebar compact command
After fix, closing a ticket produces no SNAPSHOT, no retired sources, and no ticket: COMPACT commit, with compaction moved to out-of-band scheduled execution
